objective: Gate 4D R4: reemplazar solamente el cuerpo del paso Execute GO batches transactionally por el runner canonico edarsahub_sql_runner.py y modificar el marker existente para re-disparar el workflow. Reutilizar V2 sin cambios. No DML. No Production.

actions.old:
python - <<'PY'
          import os,re,pymssql,pathlib
          sql=pathlib.Path(os.environ['MIGRATION_SCRIPT']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          batches=[b.strip() for b in re.split(r'(?im)^\s*GO\s*$',sql) if b.strip()]
          if len(batches)!=4: raise SystemExit(f'EXPECTED_4_BATCHES_GOT_{len(batches)}')
          c=pymssql.connect(server=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_HOST'],port=int(os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PORT']),database=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_DATABASE'],user=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_USER'],password=os.environ['EDARSAHUB_SQL_PASSWORD'],autocommit=False)
          q=c.cursor()
          try:
              for b in batches: q.execute(b)
              c.commit()
          except Exception:
              c.rollback(); raise
          finally:
              q.close(); c.close()
          print('EXECUTED_4_CREATE_VIEW_BATCHES')
          PY
actions.new:
set -euo pipefail
          export EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS=true
          PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}"
